text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking with Vodka in front of the station on our day off, when…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Th-that's awesome!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Check out those guys over there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka's looking at a group of rugged-looking men in leather jackets chatting with each other.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Those jackets they're wearing are vintage—I'm talkin' fifty years back!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's no mistakin' those star-shaped studs either! Pops has always dreamed of wearin' that brand!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's crazy! They're sooo cool!
choice_data_list: You really like leather jackets, huh?
You really like leather jackets, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 'cause they're so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My dad likes them too, so sometimes I borrow his…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The feeling of genuine leather really is on a whole 'nother level! The more you wear it, the more comfortable it gets. Didja know that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …I've only got a cheap one made of fake leather, though.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I still like it, of course, but the real thing just shines like a beaut!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'd love to have one…
choice_data_list: You could go take one of theirs by force…
Keep on wearing the one you have and it'll get there.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Are you crazy?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Like I'd do something as lame as that!
choice_data_list: Sorry! It was just a bad joke.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jokes aside, I tell her that she could always ask them to show her their jackets.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You think so? But wouldn't it be rude if I just came up out of nowhere?
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll be fine if you're polite about it.
I'm sure it'll be fine if you're polite about it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but… What would I even say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka suddenly starts fidgeting. I guess she gets shy around people she doesn't know. In that moment…

text_block_list.name: Man in Leather Jacket A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you two! You keep lookin' over here… You got a problem?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Agh! I-I mean… Uhhh…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: U-umm… Your jackets… They're first-edition BoTTs, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka summons her courage and talks to them. Soon after…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's amazing! They're in such good condition! And check out that shine!

text_block_list.name: Man in Leather Jacket A
text_block_list.text: Right? You sure know your stuff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka's getting along great with the guys in leather jackets.

text_block_list.name: Man in Leather Jacket B
text_block_list.text: Hey, you wanna try mine on? It's wicked comfy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Can I really?! Hell yeah I wanna try it on!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! It's wicked heavy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Um, do you mind if I take a picture? I wanna brag to my pops!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka seems quite satisfied after a long, animated discussion about biker fashion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I assure Vodka that her jacket will be just as cool as theirs someday.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah… you're right. It will!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All I've gotta do is wear it a bunch and it'll look just as vintage as theirs!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, it's decided then! I'm gonna put in the time to make this the best leather jacket there is!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: With these two hands… I'm gonna craft the pinnacle of all coolness!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as Vodka starts to get really fired up…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… But I wonder how long that'll take…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know! I bet I can speed things up by wearing it out in the rain!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Damage is definitely the fastest way to bring out that vintage look!
choice_data_list: Is it really cool if you force it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmm. You've got a point…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My dad did tell me some things are cool because they take time to age.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But… sitting around and waiting just isn't my style!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer. Let's run down the road so fast my jacket gets dirty!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This jacket'll tell my story—about how hard-boiled I am, of course!
